attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Physician Assistants

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 40 hours in courses/programs meeting AMA or AAPA Category I criteria
rules.audit_note: Attest under penalty of perjury at renewal; submit proof of CE on Board request.

topics.who: PAs who prescribe controlled substances: training under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(e) (pain management, opioid abuse/addiction risk, SUD screening, counseling, safe quantities, opioid antagonists); hours not stated on these pages
All applicants/licensees: domestic and sexual violence training (M.G.L. c. 112, s. 264); not repeated once a Board-approved course is completed unless the Board requires it

rules.notes: Renew every odd year by March 1; late fee after expiration. 100 hours per renewal period including 4 h pharmacology and 40 h Category I.
